note: Phase 6B.3 Option X follow-up — hoist writer._lazy_alloc to top of dispatch fork. vLLM 0.7.3 V0's graph_runner.capture() runs the model once eagerly to populate state BEFORE entering torch.cuda.graph() context. That warmup forward hit the self-resolve path (is_current_stream_capturing returned False, correctly), tried ensure_seq_state, and crashed because writer wasn't allocated. Fix: lazy_alloc the writer at top of dispatch fork regardless of in_capture branch. Synthetic warmup block_tables are all zeros, so ensure_seq_state(0) consumes one slot total, then captured forward (with allocated writer) goes through capture branch with persistent buffer.
